text:
mika: Pushing a canary for quokka13b (hybrid int6 + fp16 per-layer) to the a100-24g pool. Canary config: microbatch=8, max_new_tokens=2048, kv_prefetch=on. Seeing memory fragmentation and a couple of OOMs within 20 minutes. tagging @jordan for allocator/serving hints

jordan: thx. any logs? is this during long-context evals or steady short chats?

mika: mostly long-context QA evals (1.5k prompt + ~500 gen). OOM trace: 

```
ERR OOM: failed alloc 350MB (kv-cache)
slot_compactor: unable to coalesce free slot, fragmentation 72%
serving: microbatch=8 seq=2500 peak_gpu=22.3GB
```

mika: also saw spikes when multiple requests with max_new_tokens >=1500 hit the same worker.

sylvie: hybrid int6 is great for fp16 passthrough, but per-layer scale mismatch can blow up KV cache headers. try reducing max_new_tokens default and soften prefetch for the canary.

jordan: agree. quick mitigation: 1) drop microbatch -> 4 2) clamp max_new_tokens default -> 1024 3) enable kv_trim_threshold=0.6 so we evict older prefixes sooner. Also we have a small allocator patch (slot_compactor_v2) that avoids holding partial free slots; wanna try it next.

mika: can we do that as a fast canary rollback (no code change) by forcing runtime flags? or need binary change for the compactor?

jordan: runtime flags for microbatch/max_new_tokens/kv_trim yes. compactor_v2 needs tiny runtime deploy (lib change) but it's safe. can do canary with flags first.

bench-robot: quick perf numbers from the current failing canary (microbatch=8): p50=220ms, p95=740ms, tokens/second=160, cost/token baseline is +18% due to requeues from OOM. memory fragmentation metric F=0.72.

ops-bot: deploy note: canary quokka13b->pool-a100-24g at 2026-02-15T14:02:00Z (meta: canary/3)

mika: applying runtime flags now: microbatch=4 max_new_tokens=1024 kv_prefetch=off kv_trim_threshold=0.6

jordan: run a small synthetic with long-context to stress KV behaviour. also set slot_compactor.cleanup_interval=10s to reduce buildup for now.

mika: ran synthetic 200 requests with seq ~2100. No OOMs observed in 30m. Fragmentation dropped to 44%. Perf: p50=260ms, p95=820ms, tokens/s=140. Slight latency impact but stable.

sylvie: that looks acceptable for now. followups: 1) backport slot_compactor_v2 to runtime (low risk) 2) run quant calibration on a per-layer scale to reduce header blowups 3) adjust default max_new_tokens for quokka13b template to 1024 and document recommended microbatch mappings.

jordan: opened PR for slot_compactor_v2 and a small test harness: https://phab/review/CR-9812 (runs on canary pool)

mika: opening onboarding checklist ticket to capture defaults and known quirks: https://planner/tickets/ML-QUOKKA-ONBOARD. will set doc note about preferring microbatch 4-6 for long-context workloads.

bench-robot: queued LVQA runs with calibration set. will post regression numbers in the ticket.

mika: marking this canary thread resolved for now, will re-open if we see recurrence after compactor deploy. thanks all :thumbsup:
